evidence: Copernicus Marine documents that legacy product GLOBAL_ANALYSIS_FORECAST_PHY_001_024 was deprecated and replaced by operational GLOBAL_ANALYSISFORECAST_PHY_001_024; the current product DOI is 10.48670/moi-00016.

The EDI package identifier edi.200.6 remains a documented public data-package identity; independent records identify it as the Carey et al. high-frequency reservoir profile dataset and map it to the persistent PASTA DOI recorded as CR000334.
The persistent PASTA DOI is repeatedly resolved/cited as the EDI high-frequency reservoir-profile dataset used by the PGA-LSTM case study discussed in paper 716.
